summary: Image Prompt Skill generated a structured visual asset outline for downstream multimodal planning. It defines visual asset types, source fields, proof dependencies, composition constraints, forbidden elements, audit gates, and downstream handoff fields without generating final image prompts or direct model-ready descriptions.

responsibility_boundary: Translate upstream Agent artifacts into visual asset structure specifications.
Define multimodal fields for asset goals, platforms, audiences, selling points, visual constraints, proof dependencies, and compliance gates.
Preserve upstream risk fields, assumptions, proof requirements, forbidden elements, and human review requirements.
Prepare structured handoff fields for Brand Compliance Agent, Growth Metrics Agent, Creative Package Reporter, and a future image prompt generation node.

audience_assumptions_to_validate: 户外运动爱好者可能优先被防抖、防水和固定方式证明打动。
旅行内容创作者会重视一人出行、多平台复用和轻量剪辑流程。
数码发烧友会通过样片、参数解释和真实评测建立购买信心。
内容平台种草到天猫、京东等承接渠道的转化路径需要数据验证。
selling_point_claim_risks: 高清运动视频不得表达为行业第一、画质最好或全面超越手机。
运动防抖不得表达为百分百稳定、任何运动都不抖或不会产生废片。
裸机防水与耐用机身必须补充等级、深度、时长和使用条件。
AI 自动剪辑不得表达为自动生成爆款或保证内容表现。
竞品比较必须保持类目级，不攻击具体品牌。
platform_strategy_constraints: 抖音视觉素材不得暗示直播间成交结果。
小红书视觉素材不得承诺普通用户必然获得专业大片效果。
天猫视觉素材中的参数和防水耐用表达必须有证据。
京东视觉素材的类目对比不得攻击具体品牌。
creative_copy_constraints: 视觉素材只能承接文案结构模块，不得生成正文或图片 Prompt。
claim source map 中的高风险声明必须先由 Brand Compliance Agent 审核。
proof waitlist 未完成前不得进入最终图片 Prompt 生成。

do_not_claim: 不要声称行业第一，除非有权威证明
不要使用绝对化表述，如最好、唯一、百分百稳定
不要攻击具体竞品品牌
不要承诺任何场景下都不会损坏
不要暗示普通用户无需学习即可达到专业摄影师水平
compliance_rules: 涉及防水、防摔、续航等能力时需要保留条件描述

图片 Prompt 不生成真实品牌 Logo 或未经授权的名人形象
negative_constraints: 不要把项目包装成单一品牌专属工具
不要只强调参数，必须转化为用户利益点
不要生成夸张失真的户外极限画面

reusability_notes.agent_product_value: This Skill turns multimodal generation into a governed workflow stage: it plans visual structures, preserves upstream evidence boundaries, and gates final prompt generation behind compliance review.

Brand Compliance Agent.handoff_note: Review visual structures, high-risk claims, forbidden elements, asset authorization, and proof dependencies before final image prompt generation.

Growth Metrics Agent.handoff_note: Use visual asset types and selling point mappings to design later creative variant measurement and素材复用率 tracking.

Creative Package Reporter.handoff_note: Use these fields to show multimodal workflow traceability, governance, reusable Skill design, and audit state in the final package report.

preconditions: proof materials available for high-risk claims
Future Image Prompt Generation Node.handoff_note: Only this future gated node should generate model-specific image prompts after approvals are complete.

risks: This outline is not an approved image prompt and must not be used directly in any image generation model.
Proof materials and brand asset authorization are still required for multiple high-risk visual claims.
Final image prompt generation must wait for Brand Compliance Agent approval and human-in-the-loop review.
next_actions: Pass visual structures, forbidden elements, proof dependencies, and risk register to Brand Compliance Agent.
Pass asset types, platform fit, and selling point mappings to Growth Metrics Agent for future variant measurement.

Only after compliance approval, pass approved structures to a future Image Prompt Generation Node.
